claims.claim_ar: استخدام أَنَّ (الجوْلة/الاسناد) في الجملة التكميليّة بعد ذكر النِّعَم لبيان قطعية الأمر وتأكيده: «وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ».
claims.claim_en: Use of 'anna' (a complement/cognate particle) in the appended clause after mentioning the bounties to state the definiteness of the matter and to emphasize assurance: 'and that Allah does not let the reward of the believers be lost.'
claims.needs_review_reason: The source chunk contains the lemma form 'انّ' (without hamza/diacritic) rather than the exact vocalized form 'أَنَّ' in the ayah; the claim is an interpretive identification (function of أَنَّ) inferred from the ayah's structure rather than a direct quotation in the provided chunks.

claims.claim_ar: تكرار لفظ الجلالة في الآية (مِنَ اللَّهِ ... وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ ...) كوسيلة بلاغية للتوكيد والتشديد على مصدر النِعَم والضمان الإلهي.
claims.claim_en: Repetition of the Divine name in the verse (min Allah ... wa anna Allah ...) as a rhetorical means to emphasize and stress the source of the favors and the divine guarantee.
